alternatives.option: keep it as a tail fallback behind the bundle

context: Designed (design-only, no code changed) the plugin-bundled-server workaround for node-without-npm environments: esbuild single-file bundle committed at plugin/server/twining-server.mjs + plugin/server/public/, launched via sh -lc login shell running plugin/server/launch.sh with fallback ladder TWINING_SERVER_JS override > project-local ./node_modules/twining-mcp/dist/index.js > bundled file; npx removed from the plugin launch path entirely. Release: bundle rebuilt at release points by bump-plugin-version.sh, CI freshness-diff + stdio boot smoke test guard the committed artifact.
rationale: the bundle ships with the plugin so it is always present when launch.sh runs; an npx tail would only mask a corrupted install, reintroduce network dependence and hook/server version skew, and make failures unpredictable. npx remains documented only for non-plugin direct .mcp.json users.
summary: Chose to drop npx entirely from the plugin launch path rather than keep it as a tail fallback behind the bundle
